paragraphs.text: The Battle of Aster Fall was the final battle between Adam Carthalion and the Battlemage Ravidel around 4180 AR . The monumental battle took place on the plains of Ephren and forever marked the legacy of the Carthalion family.

For years, Ravidel had manipulated Adam, convincing him to pursue a dangerous quest that ultimately led to the death of his wife, Gwendolyn Carthalion . Having unwittingly fallen victim to Ravidel’s lies, Adam sought to save Dominaria from the very threat he had been tricked into supporting. In the autumn of 4180, Adam Carthalion traveled west with his army to attend the Festival of the Arena in Estark . At the same time, Ravidel invaded the Plains of Ephren on his Planar Barge for the second time.

The battle itself was fierce. Despite Adam’s brave efforts and strategic planning, he was overwhelmed by Ravidel’s might. Mortally wounded by a devastating Syphon Soul spell cast by Ravidel, Adam’s strength waned, and with his dying breath, he entrusted his infant son, Jared Carthalion , marked with the sigil of the new moon, to his loyal spellsquire, Ezer . Adam’s final act of defiance was a powerful Backdraft spell, heavily damaging Ravidel’s barge and obliterating himself in the process. The flames consumed him, but his sacrifice would not be in vain.

As Adam fell, Ezer took up the responsibility of safeguarding Jared, though the young child’s fate had already been sealed. The Syphon Soul spell had a strange effect on Jared, altering his appearance. His hair fell away, and a crescent moon mark appeared on his cheek. Ezer, shaken by the transformation, harshly remarked that Jared had become “a freak,” though it was unclear whether the boy’s physical change would have any lasting implications.

This tragic event, now known as the Battle of Aster Fall, marked the beginning of Jared Carthalion’s journey, one that would be defined by loss, hardship, and the mysterious powers passed down through his bloodline. With the death of his father and the fall of his once-great family, Jared was left to navigate a world where he was no longer recognized as the rightful heir to the Carthalion name. The battle had cost Adam everything, but his son’s survival became a symbol of hope, even as the shadows of Ravidel’s schemes lingered on.

Aster Fall is the name given to the Planeswalker Ravidel 's master conspiracy to take over Dominaria . Behind the scenes, the name was the idea of Jeff Gomez , a play on "aster", the Greek word for star. A falling star was considered a bad omen, so a catastrophe was thought to be caused by the influence of an evil star, which is where the word "disaster" comes from.
